name: Notion Developer Platform
desc: Platform for code that syncs data and extends Notion agents.
desc_zh: 用代码同步数据、给 Notion 智能体加工具的开发平台
solves: Agents could only use what the built-in connectors offered. Now you write code that syncs any data you name and adds custom agent tools.
solves_zh: 以前智能体只能用现成连接器给的数据。现在你可以写代码同步任何数据源，再给它加上自定义工具。
best_for: Your CRM has no Notion connector and your agents keep answering from stale spreadsheets.
best_for_zh: 你的 CRM 没有 Notion 连接器，智能体总是拿着过时的表格在回答。
notes: 外部发现补录（发现渠道：D — https://www.notion.com/releases/page/2）。 Shipped as Notion 3.5. It bundles Workers (code that runs on Notion infrastructure), database sync (beta), custom agent tools (beta), inbound webhooks (beta) and an External Agents API alpha behind a waitlist; External Agents became usable on 2026-07-01 and are a separate candidate. A Developer Portal section appeared in the workspace sidebar on 2026-08-19. Notion Workers are treated as part of this platform, not as their own entry. developers.notion.com redirects to the API quickstart, which is what homepage_check records. No media source was read. 首次公开日期来源：https://www.notion.com/releases/2026-05-13 官网未直接确认（redirect->https://developers.notion.com/guides/notion-api/quick-start）。
